text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today, we conducted the early morning training that Calstone Light O had requested.
choice_data_list: Looking good! Looks like you'll get a great time!
Looking good! Looks like you'll get a great time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O crosses the finish line... but
without slowing down, she bolts straight
out of Tracen Academy!
choice_data_list: Where are you going, Light O!?
Where are you going, Light O!?

text_block_list.name: High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume with straight black hair...?
Can't say I've seen her.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man
text_block_list.text: If you mean that kid, she ran off toward the riverbed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Searching for Calstone Light O,
I arrived at the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Hmm, seems I ended up focusing a little too hard.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
To think I had run off the track
without even realizing it...
choice_data_list: You're getting way too into it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: How's that! This is the real me!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My passion for reaching top speed
hasn't changed one bit even now!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: There, good job! Looking splendid, me! Keep it up, me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems in great spirits after being able to run just as she wanted.
Indeed, her running today
was nothing short of wonderful.
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it, she was timing her laps.)
(Come to think of it, she was timing her laps.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her record etched on the screen.
It was just a tiny bit faster than yesterday.
